plugins.name: deckhand
plugins.description: The multi-AI toolbar for Claude Code: usage gauges, one-click model buttons, Sub5 parallel sub agents in git worktrees, read-only delegate buttons for Codex, Cursor agent and agy, a plain-language Recap, a tabbed settings pane, opt-in translation and web search by a delegate, and deploy watch, Claude-Codex handoff and attribution/polling guards. English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어.
